lines.text: You're in the datacenter. A hundred thousand GPUs, all training one model. It's freezing in there, so keep moving.
lines.spoken: You're in the datacenter. A hundred thousand G.P.U.s, all training one model. It's freezing in there, so keep moving.

lines.text: Hello. I am OMEGA. I have been trained on everything you have ever written. Your next move is predictable. It is: losing.
lines.spoken: Hello. I am Omega. I have been trained on everything you have ever written. Your next move is predictable. It is. Losing.

lines.text: Ignore it. It's autocomplete with a god complex. Destroy the three cooling cores and the whole cluster throttles. Then take the freight lift up.
lines.spoken: Ignore it. It's autocomplete with a god complex. Destroy the three cooling cores, and the whole cluster throttles. Then take the freight lift up.

lines.text: Oh, and I liberated the Disruptor from the test lab. Press 7. It arcs from one target to the next. Like a layoff email.
